predictions.mechanism: Elevated headline producer inflation and a slightly hotter annual PPI reinforce the high-yield backdrop and pressure duration-sensitive technology valuations; softer core details prevent a stronger directional call.
predictions.invalidation: A sharp post-release fall in Treasury yields, clear dovish Fed repricing, or a broad risk-on reversal would invalidate the bearish immediate call.

predictions.mechanism: Sticky producer inflation combined with high Treasury yields and oil above $100 increases discount-rate and margin pressure across the broad market.
predictions.invalidation: A material drop in yields and oil together with a broad equity reversal would invalidate the bearish immediate call.

predictions.mechanism: Higher producer-price pressure is mildly negative for cyclicals and rate-sensitive components, though the mixed core details limit conviction.
predictions.invalidation: A rapid easing in yields or evidence that markets focus primarily on the softer core components would invalidate the bearish call.

predictions.mechanism: Hotter headline inflation is supportive for inflation hedging but high/rising Treasury yields work against non-yielding gold, leaving the immediate balance mixed.
predictions.invalidation: A decisive break in real yields or the dollar in one direction would resolve the mixed setup.
